summary: This video covers the 9th anniversary quiz promo code for Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Creator Suzi Plays demonstrates redeeming the code DECRESCENT to receive 15 Heliolite Dice from the in-game mail. She also mentions her ongoing creator promo code SUZIPLAYS0003 for extra reward bonuses. Finally, she briefly shows her Season 7 progress and equipped hero Vinyara.
